newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, growth for blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, growth for blue chips.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed on Thursday, with blue chips posting new gains as trade slumped.
* Eight of 16 active issues rose, six fell and two were flat.
* Volume halved at 4,837 units, turnover down to 2.8 million kuna from 10 million.
* Biggest gainer hotelier Arenaturist added seven kuna or 5.18 percent to 142 kuna, with 141 units sold.
* Top loser was hotelier Riviera Porec, dipping 15 kuna or 8.57 percent to 160 on volume of 351 shares.
* Food processor Podravka was most actively traded stock with 2,527 shares, closing one kuna lower at 307. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
